title: VooPoo Argus G2 Mini Pod Vape Kit - 2 Pack
description: Please Note: This device does not include a USB-C charging cable. One can be purchased separately here . The Voopoo Argus G2 Mini Pod Vape Kit is a versatile, high-performance pod system designed for both MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) and RDL (Restricted Direct-to-Lung) vaping styles. With its compact and ergonomic design, this kit fits comfortably in your hand, making it perfect for on-the-go vaping. The Argus G2 Mini is built with sturdy aluminium and PC materials, ensuring durability and a sleek, modern look. Powered by Voopoo’s advanced GENE.AI chipset, this device intelligently matches the power output to your pod’s coil resistance, enhancing flavour and vapour production for a consistently enjoyable vape. Customise your vaping experience further with precise airflow adjustments, ranging from tight MTL to loose MTL to RDL. The built-in 1200mAh battery provides reliable all-day performance and recharges quickly with its USB-C connection. The 2ml top-filling pod design makes refilling easy and mess-free, without the need to remove the pod from the device. The Argus G2 Mini is compatible with the full range of Argus Pods , offering a variety of vaping options to experiment with. With its intuitive auto-inhale activation feature, the Argus G2 Mini offers a seamless and rewarding vaping experience, making it an excellent choice for both new and experienced adult vapers. We recommend using 50/50 (freebase) or Nic Salts E-Liquid Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
